title: Practical digital support for growing businesses.
story: I'm James, a freelance digital specialist based in Lagos, Nigeria. I help e-commerce stores and small businesses work more effectively across Google's business and measurement tools. My focus is on making complex setup and troubleshooting work clearer, more organized and easier to act on.
specialty: My work focuses on Google Merchant Center (GMC), Google Business Profile (GMB), Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM), alongside e-commerce website and store support.
why: I enjoy helping business owners solve digital problems, understand what is happening behind the scenes and move forward with a clear plan.
